# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

Reviewed the submitted diff and key changed files end-to-end. I found two blocking issues: the patch is scoped to alkalinity budget/tracing work instead of the requested provenance-metadata bead, and the new alkalinity regression file is untracked so the actual patch ships without those tests.

## Amendments

1. Blocking: this patch does not implement tanksim-6e5.7.2’s provenance/confidence work at all. The touched code is alkalinity accounting and tracing in `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:10`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:67`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/water_change.rs:128`, and `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229`; none of the required parameter families received `ParamMeta`/confidence annotations, no chemistry/ecology/shrimp data source was enriched, and no developer-facing summary/doc was added. As submitted, the bead’s acceptance criteria remain unmet.
   Rationale: Merging this would close the wrong problem: the code changes are for alkalinity budget tracking, not the provenance metadata task described in the prompt.
2. Verification gap: the new regression coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1` is still untracked, so it is not part of the actual `git diff` patch. That means the production changes in `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:67`, `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs:64`, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/water_change.rs:99` would land without the intended alkalinity regression suite.
   Rationale: The working tree contains tests, but the submitted patch does not. Reviewing the patch as it would merge, coverage for the new behavior is missing.
